plain: This story is about a pilot named Kenneth Arnold and what he saw from his plane in 1947, which many see as one of the first modern UFO sightings. A whistleblower, David Grusch, says Arnold was searching for a crashed cargo plane near Mount Rainier, in Washington state, two months before the famous Roswell case, a reported crash in New Mexico. A writer billed as a CIA historian, Peter Levenda, says Arnold was flying a mission in the Pacific Northwest and the Rockies and saw a group of odd craft moving at impossible speeds. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, simply points to it as a classic example. If true, it would mean unknown craft were flying over America in 1947.
